items.title: [Bugfix] compressed-tensors: mixed-precision checkpoints silently load unquantized
items.body:
## Motivation

A multi-group ("mixed-precision") compressed-tensors checkpoint currently loads **completely unquantized** in SGLang, and never says so. Two independent bugs cause it; either one alone is enough.

**1. `ignore` is matched by raw substring.**

```python
# python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/compressed_tensors/utils.py
def check_equal_or_regex_match(layer_name, targets):
    for target in targets:
        if _is_equal_or_regex_match(layer_name, target, check_contains=True):   # <-- here
            return True
```

`check_contains=True` was added as a one-line drive-by in #14572 (`[NPU] optimization for dsv3.2`) with no test; vLLM's equivalent matches exactly. llm-compressor writes **parent** modules into `ignore` — e.g. `model.layers.0.mlp.experts.0`, a container that owns no weights of its own — so such an entry becomes a substring match for its own quantized children (`model.layers.0.mlp.experts.0.gate_proj`), and `should_ignore_layer` returns `True` for them.

`get_moe_scheme` then returns `None`, `get_quant_method` falls back to `UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod`, and the experts are allocated in **bf16**.

**2. The activation-quantization gate reads the top-level `format`.**

When config_groups disagree, compressed-tensors sets the top-level `format` to `mixed-precision` and puts the real format on each group. `_quantization_scheme_map_from_config` only consults the top-level value, so `input_activations` is set to `None` for **every** group, and afterwards no W4A4/W8A8 scheme can match — `_get_scheme_from_parts` raises `NotImplementedError: No compressed-tensors compatible scheme was found.` vLLM already prefers the per-group format here.

### How it surfaces

Reported at https://huggingface.co/beyoru/KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev-VL-Flash/discussions/1 on a Qwen3.5-VL MoE checkpoint (NVFP4 experts + FP8 attention/GDN projections):

- 2× RTX 5090 → **OOM no matter what**, because the experts are allocated bf16 in `create_weights`, before any weight is read.
- 1× RTX PRO 6000 (96 GB, enough to allocate) → reaches `load_weights` and dies with
  `KeyError: 'model.layers.0.mlp.experts.w2_input_global_scale'`, plus
  `Parameter model.layers.0.linear_attn.{in_proj_qkvz,out_proj}.weight_scale not found in params_dict`.

Neither message points at "this layer was silently de-quantized". On that checkpoint, **30810** quantized modules were swallowed by the ignore list under SGLang's matcher, and **0** under vLLM's.

This is not specific to one model: any compressed-tensors checkpoint whose `ignore` list names a parent module hits bug 1, and the whole Unsloth Dynamic NVFP4 line ships `format: "mixed-precision"` and hits bug 2.

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/compressed_tensors/utils.py`

- `check_equal_or_regex_match` no longer uses substring matching. A plain (non-regex) target matches an exact layer name **or a dotted-path suffix** of it, so suffix-style targets keep working (`self_attn.kv_b_proj` still matches `model.layers.0.self_attn.kv_b_proj`, which is what #14572 needed) while a parent module can no longer swallow its children. Regex targets are unchanged.
- `_is_equal_or_regex_match(..., check_contains=True)` is untouched — `find_matched_target` still uses it for `module.__class__.__name__` lookups, same as vLLM.

`python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/compressed_tensors/compressed_tensors.py`

- `_quantization_scheme_map_from_config` stores the per-group `format` in the scheme dict (which `get_scheme_dict`'s docstring already advertises but nothing ever populated) and gates activation parsing on it, falling back to the top-level format when a group does not declare one.
- `_get_scheme_from_parts` takes an optional `format` and uses it instead of `self.quant_format`; `get_linear_scheme` threads `scheme_dict["format"]` through.

Single-group checkpoints are unaffected: with no per-group `format`, the top-level value is used exactly as before.

Not addressed here, listed for follow-up:

- `_is_wint4afp8` / `_is_wint4abf16` still compare `self.quant_format` against `pack-quantized`, so a mixed-precision checkpoint containing an INT4 pack-quantized group would need the same per-group treatment. No such checkpoint is known today, and threading the format into the MoE predicates is a larger change.
- `packed_modules_mapping` is read only from `quantization_config` in `config.json`, never from the model class attribute (vLLM injects the model class one). Without it, a fused module such as Qwen3.5's `linear_attn.in_proj_qkvz` cannot be resolved against unfused targets and raises `ValueError: Unable to find matching target`.
